hypotheses.justification: The proof never uses `_hB`. The two nontrivial steps are `Rules.permute` (`mixedMoment B A label = mixedMoment B (fun i j => A (ρ i) (σ j)) (label ∘ σ)`) and `Rules.delete_zero_row`, and both are proved only from `mixedMoment_factor_permutation`, `mixedMoment_row_permutation` and `mixedMoment_zero_first_row` (see `lean/OAI/Analysis/MutuallyUnbiased/MixedSemantics/Rules.lean`, `.../MixedMoments/MixedMoments.lean`, `.../MixedMoments/MixedReduction.lean`), none of which assumes `IsMUBFamily B` or any property of `B` at all; they are pure permutation/collapse identities about the averages defining `mixedMoment`. The last step is `rfl`, i.e. definitional. Hence the statement `mixedMoment B raw22866 raw22866Labels = mixedMoment B node2467 node2467Labels` holds for every `B : Fin 7 → Basis` (indeed the same proof term works verbatim after the binder is removed), so `_hB` can be deleted. No degenerate case arises since nothing about `B` is used. (These generated certificate lemmas are used elsewhere in contexts that supply `hB`; that does not make the argument needed here.)
